g.text: Where the all-age bachelor’s coefficient comes from
Both panels separately sum to the same all-age coefficient. These are algebraic regression contributions, not jobs lost or causal effects.
Occupation contributions use the original FWL regression weights. Age allocation uses changes from 2022 and a logarithmic-mean identity.
An age contribution differs from the separate age-group regression coefficient shown in the companion figure.
